requirements.text: A Click option using IntRange(0, 5) accepts integer text 3, converts it to integer 3, exits successfully, and passes 3 to the command callback.
The closed lower boundary 0 of IntRange(0, 5) is accepted unchanged and the command exits successfully.
The closed upper boundary 5 of IntRange(0, 5) is accepted unchanged and the command exits successfully.
Without clamping, value -1 below IntRange(0, 5) is rejected with CLI exit 2 and a message that -1 is not in the range 0<=x<=5.
Without clamping, value 6 above IntRange(0, 5) is rejected with CLI exit 2 and the message 6 is not in the range 0<=x<=5.
With IntRange(0, 5, clamp=True), value -1 is clamped to closed lower boundary 0 and the command exits successfully.
With IntRange(0, 5, min_open=True, clamp=True), input 0 is outside the open lower boundary and clamps inward to integer 1.
With IntRange(0, 5, max_open=True, clamp=True), input 5 is outside the open upper boundary and clamps inward to integer 4.

test_cases.title: IntRange accepts an interior integer
preconditions: A Click command has required option --value with type IntRange(0, 5).
test_cases.expected_outcome: Interior text is converted to the same integer.

steps.action: Invoke the command at the lower bound.
Invoke the command at the upper bound.

test_cases.title: Value below range is rejected without clamping
preconditions: The command option uses IntRange(0, 5) with clamp disabled.

steps.expected_result: Exit 2 and output contains -1 is not in the range 0<=x<=5.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Out-of-range input does not reach the callback.

test_cases.title: Value above range is rejected without clamping
preconditions: The command option uses IntRange(0, 5) with clamp disabled.

steps.expected_result: Exit 2 and output contains 6 is not in the range 0<=x<=5.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Out-of-range input does not reach the callback.

test_cases.title: Closed lower clamping returns the minimum
preconditions: The command option uses IntRange(0, 5, clamp=True).

test_cases.title: Open lower clamping moves inward
preconditions: The command option uses IntRange(0, 5, min_open=True, clamp=True).

steps.action: Invoke at the excluded lower boundary.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Integer clamping moves one step inside the open minimum.

test_cases.title: Open upper clamping moves inward
preconditions: The command option uses IntRange(0, 5, max_open=True, clamp=True).

steps.action: Invoke at the excluded upper boundary.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Integer clamping moves one step inside the open maximum.

warnings: Bounded feature — eight deterministic IntRange behaviors only.
